chapter: Arriving in New York: the Nest Club and Harlem nightlife
title: Trumpeters jam at the Nest Club
summary: Sidney De Paris and Bobby Stark came in to jam and audition.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Now, I had just played... Sidney De Paris used to come in and jam. Quite a few trumpet players used to come in there and jam. Bobby Stark came through there a couple of times.
He was a trumpet player, too, wasn't he.

Yeah, he was with Chick Webb. They wanted somewhere to jam and play, so Harry would put them on. Sometimes we'd go to work at ten o'clock, and see half-a-dozen musicians there with their horns. They wanted to play, and also at the same time make auditions.
